mentions.name: Regional dinner club
mentions.description: A dinner club that partners with a single restaurant each month to serve a 10-20+ course, all-inclusive prix fixe menu, served family style and authentic to a featured region. Dinners are held on Tuesdays or Wednesdays to bring business to restaurants during slower midweek nights. It has grown to over 900 members, hosts two seatings per month, has served 1,300 guests, and generated $140k in revenue.
mentions.source_excerpt:
about a dinner club a friend and I host in our free time.

We work with a single restaurant each month to create a 10-20+ course all inclusive price fixe menu. The food is served family style and is authentic to the region we are hosting. We typically host the dinners on a Tues or Wed when the restaurants in our region aren’t too busy and could use the extra business.
